religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Denalikem — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Denalikem are a warlike martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Kemetra and Wendaki [Conquest Aristocracy (wendaki over kemetra)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, chariots, archers. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
